budget_rule: Product polish is in-scope by default, including documentation, naming, discovery, a first-run walkthrough, accessibility, and a single error-message contract, because those artifacts ARE the product.
organizing_principle: UX/product-first organizes the system around the owner's jobs-to-be-done rather than around subsystems: product polish is the control plane.

polish_items.title: SINGLE error-message contract (what happened, what it means, exact next action)
Honest status in the one cockpit (do not present BLOCKED as delivered)
One command / unique names for the owner surface
Naming and discovery model for 96 workflows plus 64 presets
One visual cockpit as a required top-level surface
Accessibility checks for any visual surface
Product-grade help topics and examples kept TRUE for 96 workflows plus 64 presets
Alias and deprecation windows to preserve muscle memory

top_level_surfaces_required: The top-level surfaces are one command, one cockpit, and one catalog, required even when no owner error has been observed against a missing surface.
unproven_kept_on_backlog: An item without a measured error reduction remains on the product backlog as unproven rather than being classified cosmetic.
